name: RoboDR - Motion outside the envelope
description: Commanded motion beyond the robot's locked profile (linear, angular or joint speed, joint torque). Observe-only: alerts, never responds.
query: event.module : "robodr" and (rule.id : "robot.motion.linear_over_envelope" or rule.id : "robot.motion.angular_over_envelope" or rule.id : "robot.motion.joint_over_envelope" or rule.id : "robot.firewall.joint_torque_out_of_envelope")
author: Singularity RD
